project_context.description: Integration of the ASER (Activity Safety Events Register) panel into the MOD Service Portal template.
project_context.goal: Remove the full-screen createPortal implementation. Render the ASER component inline within the existing shell. Migrate all hardcoded dark theme utility classes to the platform's theme CSS variables.

typography.strategy: Inherit platform typography. Do not enforce custom fonts to maintain absolute consistency with the MOD Service Portal.

layouts.shell_integration: Remove `createPortal(..., document.body)` and the `fixed inset-0 z-[100]` wrapper. Render ASER as a direct child of the portal content area (`relative flex flex-col w-full h-full`).
layouts.header: Transform the top header to match sibling tabs. Ensure spacing aligns with existing portal views.
layouts.kpi_grid: Maintain the 10-card grid but update card surfaces to use `--theme-surface` and `--theme-border`.
layouts.charts: Update recharts tooltip and axis colors to use `--theme-text-muted` and `--theme-surface`.

component_guidelines.register_analytics_toggle: Refactor to use existing platform classes: `.subtab-bar` for the container, `.subtab-pill` for the buttons, and `.is-active` for the selected state.
component_guidelines.buttons: Map custom white/dark buttons to platform-standard styles utilizing `--theme-surface-hover` or brand variables.
component_guidelines.modals: Keep the Email report modal as a centered dialog (`fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-center justify-center bg-black/50`) but the inner modal card must use `bg-[var(--theme-surface)]` and `border-[var(--theme-border)]`.
component_guidelines.wizard: Apply standard thematic inputs and selects. Remove dark-mode specific focus rings.

instructions_to_main_agent: 2. Locate the default export function returning `createPortal(...)` and rewrite it to return standard JSX elements inline without the React portal.

3. Strip all `fixed inset-0 z-[100]` and `bg-[var(--color-ink-deep)]` classes from the top-level wrapper, replacing them with a relative flex container: `relative flex flex-col w-full h-full bg-[var(--theme-surface)] text-[var(--theme-text)]`.
4. Perform a systematic replacement of `text-white` with `text-[var(--theme-text)]`.
8. Convert the Register/Analytics switch in the header to use `.subtab-bar` and `.subtab-pill` to match sibling tabs.
9. Remove the 'Close' button from the ASER header if it's no longer a full-screen overlay, or rewire it to correctly return to the parent view state (e.g. `setAserOpen(false)`).
10. For Recharts components, ensure the grid lines, axis text, and tooltips use CSS variables instead of hardcoded white/grey.
11. Add `data-testid` to all toggles, buttons, and form inputs.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Follow optical alignment over geometrical alignment.
Prioritize using pre-existing components from the platform over creating new custom ones.
Ensure no transparent backgrounds are used on dropdowns or modals where content scrolls underneath.
Never use AI assistant Emoji characters for icons.
Use modern button styles with interaction animations (hover states, transitions).
All changes must preserve the existing component structure and business logic (filters, API calls, state). ONLY the styling and DOM placement are altered.
